proposal.label: Accidental Damage
proposal.definition: External damage occurring during use, such as accidental tearing, ripping or staining, which may lead to product rejection or disposal.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific event of accidental damage, distinct from general durability or hazard classes.

proposal.label: Ageing Simulation Method
proposal.definition: A laboratory or field test method that applies controlled, repeatable use or care cycles to simulate product ageing before or during durability assessment.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific test method used in textile durability assessment, distinct from general biodegradability or other test methods.

proposal.label: Assembly Characteristic
proposal.definition: Characteristic of a garment or textile assembly, covering seams, sewing and cutting quality.
proposal.rationale: Captures the quality attributes of textile construction that affect durability and circularity.

proposal.label: Assessment Condition
proposal.definition: The set of circumstances or criteria under which a textile assessment is performed, such as environmental testing conditions or regulatory compliance checks.
proposal.rationale: This class captures the generic concept of assessment conditions needed for textile product passports, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Assessment Execution
proposal.definition: The actual performance of a textile assessment method on a specified product under defined conditions and parameter settings.
proposal.rationale: This class represents the concrete execution of a textile assessment, matching the upstream concept exactly.

proposal.label: Assessment Method
proposal.definition: The documented procedure or approach used to assess, observe, test, measure or evaluate a textile product or a durability‑related performance parameter.
proposal.rationale: This class captures the generic concept of a textile assessment method, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Assessment Parameter
proposal.definition: A configurable value or setting that qualifies, limits, or interprets a textile assessment procedure.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic concept of a parameter used in textile assessment, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Care Parameter
proposal.definition: Process parameter relevant to textile care, such as washing temperature, drying time or storage conditions.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reusable concept for individual care parameters that can be linked to specific instructions.

proposal.label: Chemical Finishing Process
proposal.definition: Finishing process that uses chemical substances or treatments to confer or modify functional properties of textile materials or products.
proposal.rationale: Captures a distinct textile finishing activity that is not represented by existing process classes.

proposal.label: Cleaning Process
proposal.definition: Care process involving domestic laundering, professional cleaning, dry cleaning or wet cleaning of a textile product.
proposal.rationale: Defines a distinct cleaning activity not covered by existing care instruction classes.

proposal.label: Coating Additive Use
proposal.definition: Process‑level record of an additive or chemical used to coat a textile material, capturing the role rather than the substance itself.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct process‑use concept for textile coatings not represented by existing substance or product classes.

proposal.label: Coating Parameter
proposal.definition: Process parameter relevant to textile coating or surface treatment, such as thickness, cure time or temperature.
proposal.rationale: Captures a generic coating‑related process parameter not covered by existing classes.

proposal.label: Coating Process
proposal.definition: Finishing process that applies a coating layer or functional surface treatment to a textile material or product.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct coating‑application concept not covered by existing classes.

proposal.label: Collection Scheme Concept
proposal.definition: SKOS concept used to classify an arrangement for collecting textile waste.
proposal.rationale: Provides a distinct concept for classifying textile waste collection schemes, not covered by existing terms.

proposal.label: Component Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Category of failure modes affecting components or trims in textile products.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic failure mode concept for textile components, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Confectioning Parameter
proposal.definition: Process parameter relevant to garment making, cutting, sewing, assembly or make‑up operations.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct parameter class for garment‑making operations not covered by existing classes.

proposal.label: Confectioning Process
proposal.definition: Manufacturing process that transforms fabrics and components into finished textile apparel or articles, including cutting, sewing and make‑up operations.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct process class for garment manufacturing not covered by existing classes.

proposal.label: Cut Precision
proposal.definition: Assembly characteristic describing the precision of cutting or pattern construction in a textile product.
proposal.rationale: Captures the quality of cutting that influences durability and circularity in textile assemblies.

proposal.label: Cutting Parameter
proposal.definition: Confectioning parameter relevant to cutting operations.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct parameter class for cutting operations not covered by existing classes.

proposal.label: Cutting Process
proposal.definition: Confectioning process in which textile materials are cut into components or pattern pieces.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct process class for cutting operations not covered by existing classes.

proposal.label: Defect Control
proposal.definition: Process parameter or quality‑control practice aimed at preventing or detecting defects during textile processing.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct class for defect‑control activities not covered by existing classes.

proposal.label: Deformation Performance Parameter
proposal.definition: Category of observed performance parameters related to deformation, shape retention or dimensional behaviour.
proposal.rationale: Captures a distinct class for deformation‑related performance metrics, separate from emissions or circularity classes.

proposal.label: Degradation Rate
proposal.definition: Calculated indicator expressing change in a performance parameter or degradation phenomenon per stated unit of time, use, cycle or exposure.
proposal.rationale: Provides a generic performance‑degradation metric for textile products, not covered by existing biodegradability or test method terms.

proposal.label: Discolouration
proposal.definition: Observed performance parameter describing localised, irregular or use‑specific colour change that is distinct from general colour fading.
proposal.rationale: Provides a separate class for non‑uniform or condition‑specific colour changes, complementing the broader Colour Fastness class.

proposal.label: Drying Temperature
proposal.definition: Care parameter describing the temperature used during textile drying.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct class for drying temperature, complementing the generic TemperatureRange term.

proposal.label: Dye Concentration
proposal.definition: Dyeing parameter describing the concentration of dye or colourant used in a dyeing process.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic dye concentration concept for textile processes, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Dyeing Parameter
proposal.definition: Process parameter relevant to textile dyeing.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct class for dyeing parameters, separate from visual inspection or substance terms.

proposal.label: Dyeing Process
proposal.definition: Wet processing process used to impart colour to textile fibres, yarns, fabrics or finished products.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct class for dyeing processes, separate from general textile product or visual inspection classes.

proposal.label: Dyeing Time
proposal.definition: Dyeing parameter describing the duration of a dyeing process or dyeing step.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic dyeing time concept for textile processes, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Elasticity Loss
proposal.definition: Structural failure mode describing loss of elastic recovery or stretch‑related functionality in a textile product or fabric.
proposal.rationale: Captures a specific durability failure that is distinct from general robustness or dimensional change, aligning with textile performance testing.

proposal.label: External Damage
proposal.definition: Damage caused by external or accidental events during product use, not necessarily resulting from intrinsic lack of durability.
proposal.rationale: Captures non‑intrinsic damage events that affect textile durability, distinct from internal failure modes.

proposal.label: Fabric Appearance
proposal.definition: Visual characteristic of a fabric that describes its overall visible appearance or visual quality.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic fabric visual quality concept, distinct from specific inspection sub‑ratings.

proposal.label: Fabric Behavioural Characteristic
proposal.definition: Physical behaviour of a fabric under use, gravity, movement, care or stress conditions.
proposal.rationale: Captures how a textile fabric behaves in real‑world conditions, complementing structural and visual characteristics.

proposal.label: Fabric Breakdown
proposal.definition: Aggregated failure mode of a textile fabric that may later be decomposed into specific phenomena such as fraying, thinning, localised wear or hole formation.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic fabric‑breakdown concept for textile durability, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Fabric Breathability
proposal.definition: Functional characteristic of a fabric that describes the passage of water vapour through it and its evaporative cooling effect.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of breathability, distinct from durability or compostability.

proposal.label: Fabric Construction Parameter
proposal.definition: Process-side parameter describing how a fabric construction is specified or controlled during manufacturing. The resulting observable construction characteristics are represented in TEXTILE_STRUCTURE.
proposal.rationale: Adds a distinct class for process‑controlled fabric construction parameters, separate from the generic FabricType concept.

proposal.label: Fabric Drape
proposal.definition: Behavioural characteristic describing how a fabric hangs in three dimensions and adapts to contours.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific textile property of drape, distinct from type or product class.

proposal.label: Fabric Elasticity
proposal.definition: Structural characteristic describing the elastic behaviour of a fabric.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of elasticity, distinct from type or durability.

proposal.label: Fabric Functional Characteristic
proposal.definition: Characteristic describing the functional performance of a fabric relevant to use, comfort or intended application.
proposal.rationale: Provides a generic container for any functional property of textiles that is not covered by more specific classes.

proposal.label: Fabric Handle
proposal.definition: Tactile characteristic describing the softness, smoothness, flexibility and overall sensation when a fabric is touched.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of handle, distinct from type or durability.

proposal.label: Fabric Insulation
proposal.definition: Functional characteristic describing a fabric’s ability to retain heat and reduce heat transfer.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of insulation, distinct from type or durability.

proposal.label: Fabric Lustre
proposal.definition: Visual characteristic describing the reflection of light that gives a shiny or glossy appearance to a fabric.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of lustre, distinct from type or durability.

proposal.label: Fabric Manufacturing Method Concept
proposal.definition: SKOS concept used as a controlled value for a fabric manufacturing method.
proposal.rationale: Provides a dedicated class for the controlled vocabulary of fabric manufacturing methods, distinct from generic FabricType.

proposal.label: Fabric Manufacturing Parameter
proposal.definition: Superclass covering process‑side parameters used during fabric manufacturing, excluding resulting structural characteristics.
proposal.rationale: Provides a distinct class for manufacturing parameters, separate from FabricType and product‑level characteristics.

proposal.label: Fabric Manufacturing Process
proposal.definition: Manufacturing process that transforms yarns, fibres or filaments into fabric structures.
proposal.rationale: Defines the core process concept for fabric production, distinct from product or parameter classes.

proposal.label: Fabric Mass Per Unit Area
proposal.definition: Construction characteristic expressing the mass of a fabric per unit surface area.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of fabric mass density, distinct from type or durability.

proposal.label: Fabric Rigidity
proposal.definition: Structural characteristic indicating the stiffness or rigidity of a fabric.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of rigidity, distinct from type or durability.

proposal.label: Fabric Smoothness
proposal.definition: Observed performance parameter describing the visible or tactile smoothness of a fabric surface, commonly assessed during visual inspection after washing, drying or other durability-related stress.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic fabric‑smoothness concept for textile durability, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Fabric Strength
proposal.definition: Aggregated observed mechanical performance parameter describing the strength of a fabric, potentially covering tensile strength, tear strength or bursting strength depending on the test context.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic fabric‑strength concept for textile durability, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Fabric Tactile Characteristic
proposal.definition: Fabric-level characteristic concerning touch, hand‑feel or perceived tactile behaviour.
proposal.rationale: Provides a dedicated class for the tactile feel of textiles, complementing structural and durability classes.

proposal.label: Fabric Visual Characteristic
proposal.definition: Fabric-level characteristic concerning visible appearance, lustre, shininess, sheen or other visual qualities.
proposal.rationale: Captures the visual appearance attributes of textiles, distinct from inspection results and structural properties.

proposal.label: Failure Mode
proposal.definition: A specific event or condition that causes a textile product to fail, distinct from the performance parameters that describe its normal behaviour.
proposal.rationale: Captures the discrete failure events that are separate from performance metrics, aligning with textile durability reporting.

proposal.label: Fibre Characteristic
proposal.definition: Characteristic of a textile fibre that influences yarn manufacture, fabric behaviour and durability-related performance.
proposal.rationale: Captures fibre-level properties that affect downstream textile performance, distinct from overall fabric or yarn characteristics.

proposal.label: Fibre Cleanliness
proposal.definition: Quality characteristic describing the level of impurities or foreign matter remaining in a fibre.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of fibre cleanliness, distinct from type or substance concerns.

proposal.label: Fibre Colour
proposal.definition: Visual characteristic of a textile fibre describing its colour and how that influences dyeing or bleaching behaviour.
proposal.rationale: Adds a fibre‑level colour attribute distinct from overall fabric type or substance of concern.

proposal.label: Fibre Elasticity
proposal.definition: Mechanical property of a textile fibre describing its ability to deform under load and recover when the load is removed.
proposal.rationale: Adds a fibre‑level elasticity attribute distinct from overall fabric type or recovered material.

proposal.label: Fibre Fineness
proposal.definition: Structural property of a textile fibre expressed as linear density or fineness.
proposal.rationale: Captures the fibre‑level fineness attribute, distinct from overall fabric type or essential characteristics.

proposal.label: Fibre Length
proposal.definition: Structural property of a textile fibre expressed as the length of the individual fibre.
proposal.rationale: Captures the fibre‑level length attribute, distinct from fabric type or microplastic shedding information.

proposal.label: Fibre Preparation Process
proposal.definition: Manufacturing process that prepares fibres for yarn manufacturing or textile production.
proposal.rationale: Captures the upstream step of fibre conditioning before yarn or fabric creation, distinct from other process classes.

proposal.label: Fibre Quality Characteristic
proposal.definition: Non‑structural, non‑mechanical, non‑physical or visual property of a textile fibre that influences its overall quality.
proposal.rationale: Captures fibre‑level quality attributes that are not covered by structural, mechanical or visual classes.

proposal.label: Fibre Section Shape
proposal.definition: Cross‑sectional shape of a textile fibre, such as round, oval or irregular.
proposal.rationale: Captures the structural shape of individual fibres, not covered by existing fibre or fabric type classes.

proposal.label: Fibre Strength
proposal.definition: Mechanical characteristic expressing a fibre’s resistance to tensile stress or breakage.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of fibre strength, distinct from fabric tear strength or durability class.

proposal.label: Finishing Parameter
proposal.definition: Process parameter relevant to textile finishing, including chemical and mechanical finishing.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic finishing‑parameter concept for textile processes, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Finishing Process
proposal.definition: Textile process applied to modify appearance, handle, function or physical properties of textile materials or products.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic finishing‑process concept for textile processes, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Finishing Treatment Parameter
proposal.definition: Process parameter describing a finishing treatment type, intensity, duration or configuration.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific attributes of a finishing treatment step, distinct from the overall FinishingProcess class.

proposal.label: Fixation Condition
proposal.definition: Dyeing or printing parameter describing conditions used to fix a dye, pigment, print or finish to the textile material.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific conditions that secure a dye or finish to fabric, distinct from general process classes.

proposal.label: Functional Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Category of failure modes primarily involving loss of intended use, comfort or functional suitability of a textile product.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic functional‑failure mode concept for textile durability, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Fuzzing or Matting
proposal.definition: Observed surface degradation phenomenon involving fuzzing or matting of the fabric surface, following JRC and ISO wording.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific surface‑degradation phenomenon distinct from microplastic shedding or other durability metrics.

proposal.label: Hole in Seam
proposal.definition: Specific seam failure involving a hole or localized opening at or around a seam.
proposal.rationale: Captures a distinct seam‑related defect that is not covered by general repair or durability terms.

proposal.label: Humidity Control
proposal.definition: Process parameter describing control of humidity during textile manufacturing, processing or care.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific humidity‑control step in textile processes, distinct from general process classes.

proposal.label: Incineration Process
proposal.definition: End‑of‑life process involving combustion of textile products or textile waste.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific incineration step in textile end‑of‑life treatment, distinct from general take‑back or program classes.

proposal.label: Input Yarn Count Specification
proposal.definition: Process target or input specification stating the yarn count or yarn linear‑density class selected for fabric manufacturing.
proposal.rationale: Defines the yarn‑count specification used as a manufacturing input, distinct from general textile product or fabric type classes.

proposal.label: Intermediate Textile Characteristic
proposal.definition: Property of an intermediate textile structure such as yarn, fabric or assembly that is not a final product but influences performance.
proposal.rationale: Adds a generic intermediate‑level characteristic class, distinct from overall textile product or essential characteristics.

proposal.label: Interpretation Scale
proposal.definition: A numeric or categorical scale used to interpret, classify or rate the result of a textile assessment.
proposal.rationale: Captures the scale that translates raw assessment data into a meaningful rating, distinct from the assessment method or parameter.

proposal.label: Ironing Process
proposal.definition: Confectioning or care‑related process applying heat and pressure to shape, smooth or finish textile products.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific ironing step in textile manufacturing or care, distinct from general textile product classes.

proposal.label: Knitting Pattern Specification
proposal.definition: Process target specification stating the knitting structure or pattern to be produced.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific knitting pattern target in textile manufacturing, distinct from general textile product or fabric type classes.

proposal.label: Knitting Process
proposal.definition: Fabric manufacturing process in which yarns are interlooped using needles to form fabric on knitting machines.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific knitting manufacturing step, distinct from general textile product or fabric type classes.

proposal.label: Laminating Process
proposal.definition: Finishing or assembly process joining textile materials with layers or membranes.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific laminating step in textile finishing, distinct from general textile product or fabric type classes.

proposal.label: Landfilling Process
proposal.definition: End‑of‑life process involving disposal of textile products or textile waste in landfill.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific landfill disposal step for textile waste, distinct from general end‑of‑life program classes.

proposal.label: Life Extension Intervention Aspect
proposal.definition: Product aspect concerning intervention‑based extension or restoration of textile product use, functionality or value through repair, upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing.
proposal.rationale: This class captures the textile‑specific intervention aspect that aligns with the broader lifecycle stage concept but is focused on life‑extension activities.

proposal.label: Life Extension Product Event
proposal.definition: Concrete textile process occurrence that extends, restores or substantially changes the useful life, functionality or condition of a textile product.
proposal.rationale: Captures the textile‑specific product event that aligns with the broader lifecycle stage concept but focuses on life‑extension activities.

proposal.label: Liquor Ratio
proposal.definition: Dyeing‑process parameter expressing the relation between the quantity of treatment liquor and the mass of dry textile material, with explicit reporting basis and unit.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific dyeing parameter needed for textile process reporting, not covered by existing classes.

proposal.label: Logo Failure
proposal.definition: Failure of a logo on a textile product, whether printed, embroidered or applied as a separate component.
proposal.rationale: Captures a visual‑failure mode specific to logos, distinct from general repair or durability terms.

proposal.label: Loss of Comfort
proposal.definition: Functional failure mode indicating a loss of comfort or comfort‑related suitability during use, maintenance or ageing.
proposal.rationale: Captures a specific comfort‑related failure distinct from general durability or repairability concepts.

proposal.label: Loss Of Dimensional Stability
proposal.definition: Failure expression corresponding to loss of the ability of a textile product or fabric to retain its dimensions after use, laundering or treatment cycles.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific failure mode for dimensional stability loss in textile durability, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Machinery Characteristic
proposal.definition: Process parameter or equipment characteristic describing machinery quality, configuration or components relevant to textile processing.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic machinery‑characteristic concept for textile processes, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Maintenance and Repair Process
proposal.definition: Process that extends product lifetime through maintenance or repair activities, distinct from assessment indicators.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific maintenance/repair activity class needed for textile lifecycle reporting.

proposal.label: Measurement Parameter
proposal.definition: A protocol variable that is controlled or recorded during a measurement or test, distinct from the product performance characteristic being assessed.
proposal.rationale: Captures the controlled or recorded settings that influence a measurement, separate from the assessed attribute.

proposal.label: Measurement Parameter Setting
proposal.definition: A concrete assignment of a quantitative or controlled value to a measurement parameter within an assessment execution or protocol.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific value given to a measurement parameter, distinct from the parameter definition itself.

proposal.label: Mechanical Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Category of failure modes primarily involving rupture, tearing or other mechanical damage to a textile product.
proposal.rationale: Captures a distinct mechanical failure category not represented by existing repair or durability terms.

proposal.label: Mechanical Finishing Process
proposal.definition: Finishing process that uses mechanical treatment to modify the physical properties, surface behaviour, handling or appearance of textile materials or products.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific mechanical finishing activity required for textile lifecycle reporting, distinct from other process classes.

proposal.label: Mechanical Recycling Process
proposal.definition: Recycling process mechanically transforming textile products or textile waste into reusable fibres or materials.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic mechanical recycling process for textile products, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Modularity Feature
proposal.definition: Design feature by which relevant product elements are modular, detachable or interchangeable to support repair or upgrade.
proposal.rationale: Captures the textile‑specific modularity concept, aligning with the broader component type notion used in electronics.

proposal.label: Moisture Retention
proposal.definition: Physical fibre property describing the capacity of fibres to absorb or retain moisture.
proposal.rationale: Adds a fibre‑level moisture handling characteristic, distinct from recovery or material categories.

proposal.label: Non-Textile Component
proposal.definition: A physical component integrated into a textile product that is not part of the primary textile fibre composition, such as a button, zipper or sequin.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic concept of a non‑textile component within textile products, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Non-Textile Component Material Group
proposal.definition: Material grouping associated with one or more non‑textile components, used as a location or concentration reference unit without treating the component itself as a material group.
proposal.rationale: Captures the grouping of non‑textile components for SOC reporting, distinct from textile material categories.

proposal.label: Non-Textile Component Type Concept
proposal.definition: A controlled SKOS concept used to classify the functional type of a non‑textile component integrated into a textile product, such as button, zipper or sequin.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reusable taxonomy for the functional categories of non‑textile parts that influence durability, recyclability or compliance.

proposal.label: Nonwoven Manufacturing Process
proposal.definition: Fabric manufacturing process that produces non‑woven textile structures by bonding or entangling fibres or filaments.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific non‑woven production activity required for textile lifecycle reporting, distinct from other process classes.

proposal.label: Number of Cycles
proposal.definition: The count of repeated test, washing, abrasion or simulated‑use cycles performed on a textile product during an assessment.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific measurement parameter for textile durability tests, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Observed Degradation Phenomenon
proposal.definition: Observable physical deterioration of a textile material or product, distinct from the performance characteristic that measures resistance to such degradation.
proposal.rationale: Captures a specific observable degradation event not represented by existing durability or biodegradability terms.

proposal.label: Packaging Material
proposal.definition: A material occurrence used for the packaging, transport, storage or delivery of a textile product.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic concept of a material used in textile packaging, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Packaging Material Type Concept
proposal.definition: A controlled SKOS concept used to classify a packaging material occurrence.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reusable taxonomy for the functional type of packaging materials used with textile products, supporting traceability and sustainability reporting.

proposal.label: Packaging Process
proposal.definition: Process context in which packaging material is used as an input, distinct from ordinary textile manufacturing processes.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic packaging process for textile products, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Performance Threshold
proposal.definition: A decision criterion that specifies a minimum, maximum, target or equality value against which an assessment result is evaluated.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic threshold concept used in textile performance assessments, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Pilling
proposal.definition: Observed surface degradation phenomenon involving the formation of small balls or pills of entangled fibres on a textile surface during wear, friction, use or testing.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific surface‑degradation failure mode for pilling in textile durability, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Polycotton Thermo‑Chemical Recycling Process
proposal.definition: Chemical or thermo‑chemical recycling process for polycotton blends that produces cellulosic pulp, polyester fibres, polymers or monomers depending on the applied technique.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific polycotton thermo‑chemical recycling activity required for textile lifecycle reporting, distinct from other process classes.

proposal.label: Printing Binder Use
proposal.definition: Use of a binder substance or chemical in the printing process, recorded as a process‑use aspect within TEXTILE_ASSOCIATED_MATERIALS.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific binder‑use activity in textile printing, distinct from other process classes.

proposal.label: Printing Parameter
proposal.definition: Process parameter relevant to textile printing, such as temperature, pressure or ink composition.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific printing‑parameter activity in textile manufacturing, distinct from other process classes.

proposal.label: Printing Process
proposal.definition: Textile process that applies colour, patterns or markings to textile materials or products.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific printing activity in textile manufacturing, distinct from other process classes.

proposal.label: Priority Repair Element
proposal.definition: Assessment role assigned to a product element that is important for repairability because of failure frequency or functional relevance.
proposal.rationale: Captures the textile‑specific priority repair element concept, aligning with the broader repair criterion used in electronics.

proposal.label: Process Control Parameter
proposal.definition: Parameter that controls, configures or monitors the execution conditions of a textile process.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific control‑parameter concept needed for textile process monitoring, distinct from other parameter classes.

proposal.label: Process Method Concept
proposal.definition: Controlled value representing a textile process method or technique.
proposal.rationale: Provides a dedicated concept class for enumerating textile process methods, distinct from existing product or chain‑of‑custody classes.

proposal.label: Process Parameter
proposal.definition: Semantic type for a configurable process condition, method choice, control variable or target specification relevant to a textile process.
proposal.rationale: Provides a dedicated class for representing any adjustable or targetable aspect of a textile process, distinct from existing product or chain‑of‑custody classes.

proposal.label: Process Parameter Setting
proposal.definition: Concrete value or selected category assigned to a process parameter for a specific textile process execution.
proposal.rationale: Captures the instantiated setting of a process parameter, distinct from the abstract parameter definition.

proposal.label: Product Ageing
proposal.definition: Progressive change or degradation of textile product performance over time under repeated use, care, environmental exposure or stress.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic ageing concept for textile durability, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Product Replacement Frequency
proposal.definition: Indicator of how often a product is replaced, recognising that replacement depends on durability, fit, perceived value and fashion trends.
proposal.rationale: Captures a consumer‑centric replacement metric not represented by durability or repairability terms.

proposal.label: Product Technology Level Concept
proposal.definition: A controlled concept classifying a product technology as base case, best‑available technology or best‑not‑yet‑available technology.
proposal.rationale: Captures the maturity tier of a textile product’s technology, enabling comparison across supply‑chain stages.

proposal.label: Pyrolysis or Gasification Recycling Process
proposal.definition: Thermo‑chemical process that produces syngas or pyrolysis oil for use as a feedstock in material production; fuel‑use energy recovery is not considered recycling.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific thermo‑chemical recycling pathway for textile products, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Radiation-Induced Degradation
proposal.definition: Degradation of textile material or product properties caused by exposure to ultraviolet or other relevant radiation.
proposal.rationale: Captures a specific degradation mechanism not covered by general durability or biodegradability terms.

proposal.label: Rating Scale
proposal.definition: An interpretation scale composed of controlled rating values or grades used to evaluate assessment results.
proposal.rationale: Captures the set of allowed rating values or grades applied to a textile assessment outcome, distinct from the raw result.

proposal.label: Rating Value Concept
proposal.definition: A controlled rating value, grade or scale level used as a SKOS concept in textile assessment results.
proposal.rationale: Provides the individual value that populates a RatingScale for textile assessment outcomes.

proposal.label: Recovered Material Quality Result
proposal.definition: Assessment result indicating whether recovered textile material meets the quality requirements for its intended use.
proposal.rationale: Captures the outcome of a quality check on recovered textile material, distinct from generic recovery or target classes.

proposal.label: Recovered Textile Material
proposal.definition: Material output recovered from an actual textile recycling process and potentially usable as input to another production process.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific recovered textile stream distinct from generic recovered material classes, enabling traceability of textile recycling outputs.

proposal.label: Recyclability Barrier
proposal.definition: Product, material, substance, information or system condition that hinders collection, sorting, preparation, recycling or the use and quality of recovered material for a specified route.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific concept of a barrier to recyclability, not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Recyclability Barrier Type Concept
proposal.definition: Controlled concept classifying a recyclability barrier.
proposal.rationale: Provides a controlled vocabulary for the different kinds of barriers that can impede textile recyclability, distinct from individual barrier instances.

proposal.label: Recyclability Label Concept
proposal.definition: Controlled categorical label used by a specified recyclability scoring method.
proposal.rationale: Provides a controlled vocabulary for the labels (e.g., A/B/C, 0‑10 score) that a recyclability assessment can assign to a textile product.

proposal.label: Recycled Content Assessment
proposal.definition: Assessment execution that verifies or evaluates a recycled‑content declaration for a textile product.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific act of assessing a recycled‑content declaration, distinct from the declaration itself.

proposal.label: Recycled Content Assessment Result
proposal.definition: Assessment result reporting the outcome of verifying or evaluating a recycled‑content declaration.
proposal.rationale: Captures the outcome of a recycled‑content assessment, distinct from the declaration or the assessment itself.

proposal.label: Recycled Content Performance Threshold
proposal.definition: Performance threshold defining a minimum recycled‑content value for a stated product, fibre or source context.
proposal.rationale: Captures the minimum recycled‑content requirement that a textile item must meet, distinct from declarations or assessment results.

proposal.label: Recycled Content Verification Method
proposal.definition: Assessment method used to verify a recycled‑content declaration where no direct laboratory determination of recycled versus virgin fibre origin is available at scale.
proposal.rationale: Defines the method by which recycled‑content claims are verified, distinct from declarations or assessment results.

proposal.label: Recycled Textile Fibre
proposal.definition: Recovered textile material represented as a textile fibre suitable, subject to quality and process requirements, for use in textile products.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific material type of recycled textile fibre, distinct from generic recycled content or fibre types.

proposal.label: Recycling Loop Concept
proposal.definition: Controlled concept identifying the intended material‑loop destination of a recycling route.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific loop destination concept for textile recycling, distinct from generic recycled content or rate.

proposal.label: Reference Period
proposal.definition: A structured temporal interval that specifies the period to which an observation, indicator or other time‑bound textile statement applies.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reusable representation for time intervals used in textile product passports.

proposal.label: Refurbishment Process
proposal.definition: Process involving preparation, cleaning, testing, servicing and, where necessary, repair to restore a textile product within its originally intended use and performance range.
proposal.rationale: Captures the textile‑specific refurbishment process concept, aligning with the broader repair criterion used in electronics repairability assessments.

proposal.label: Remanufacturing Possibility
proposal.definition: Potential to produce a new product from waste textiles, components or products through at least one change that may alter performance, purpose or type.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic remanufacturing capability for textiles, distinct from specific repair or refurbishment events.

proposal.label: Remanufacturing Process
proposal.definition: Process that creates a new textile product from waste textiles, components or products through at least one change that may alter performance, purpose or type, distinct from material recycling.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific remanufacturing activity for textiles, separate from generic remanufacturing possibility or recycling.

proposal.label: Repair Action Type Concept
proposal.definition: Controlled process‑method concept identifying a textile repair action such as patching, mending, button replacement or zipper replacement.
proposal.rationale: Aligns with the existing Repair Criterion Type concept, which captures repair‑action categories in a similar context.

proposal.label: Repair Actor Type Concept
proposal.definition: SKOS concept used to classify the role or category of an actor participating in textile repair.
proposal.rationale: Aligns with the generic Actor Role concept, which captures roles such as repair provider, technician or consumer in a repair context.

proposal.label: Repair Cost Condition
proposal.definition: Economic condition describing repair cost relative to a comparable new product price and its influence on a repair decision.
proposal.rationale: Captures the cost‑based decision factor for textile repair, distinct from generic repair criteria or cost property.

proposal.label: Repair Process
proposal.definition: Process that extends the usable lifetime of a textile product; links to repair‑related indicators are handled in other modules.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic repair process for textile products, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Repair-Related Life‑Extension Process
proposal.definition: Textile process type related to upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing and organised with repair under the broader family of life‑extension interventions.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific category of textile processes that extend product life through repair‑related activities, distinct from general repair criteria.

proposal.label: Repair Service Configuration Concept
proposal.definition: SKOS concept representing a BC, BAT or BNAT repair‑service and guidance configuration from JRC Table 48.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific configuration of repair services required for textile products, distinct from generic repair providers or criteria.

proposal.label: Repairability
proposal.definition: Ability of a defective textile product or waste object to return, through one or more actions, to a condition that fulfills its intended use, with user acceptance of restored functionality and possibly altered aesthetics.
proposal.rationale: Captures the broader textile‑specific repairability concept, distinct from generic repair information or index.

proposal.label: Repairability Contextual Condition
proposal.definition: Assessment condition external to intrinsic product design that influences repair feasibility or the decision to repair.
proposal.rationale: Captures external factors affecting repairability, distinct from the intrinsic product design or specific criteria.

proposal.label: Repairability Design Feature
proposal.definition: Design‑related feature that may enable repair, upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing, such as modularity, standardisation or disassembly.
proposal.rationale: Captures intrinsic product design attributes that facilitate repair, distinct from external contextual conditions or specific criteria.

proposal.label: Reuse Process
proposal.definition: End‑of‑life or post‑use process that enables a textile product to be used again without major material transformation.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic reuse activity for textiles, distinct from take‑back or end‑of‑life programs.

proposal.label: Rough or Stiff Fabric
proposal.definition: Failure mode in which a fabric becomes or is perceived as rough, stiff or unpleasant to touch, affecting user acceptance and comfort-related use.
proposal.rationale: Captures a specific tactile degradation that is not represented by general durability or robustness assessments.

proposal.label: Seam Construction Parameter
proposal.definition: Sewing parameter describing seam type, stitch, thread, construction or other seam‑related configuration.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific sewing configuration that influences durability and recyclability of a textile product.

proposal.label: Seam Failure
proposal.definition: Structural or assembly‑related failure mode involving loss of seam integrity or functionality.
proposal.rationale: Captures a specific failure mode not represented by existing repair or durability terms.

proposal.label: Seam Slippage
proposal.definition: Durability‑related assembly performance characteristic describing displacement of yarns at or near a seam under mechanical stress, which may lead to deformation or opening.
proposal.rationale: Captures a specific seam‑related failure mode not covered by general durability or repair terms.

proposal.label: Seam Strength
proposal.definition: Assembly characteristic expressing the mechanical strength or integrity of a seam.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile property of seam strength, distinct from fabric tensile or tear strength.

proposal.label: Sewing Characteristic
proposal.definition: Assembly property describing the quality or construction of sewing in a textile product.
proposal.rationale: Captures sewing‑related construction details, distinct from overall fabric type or essential characteristics.

proposal.label: Sewing Parameter
proposal.definition: Confectioning parameter relevant to sewing operations and seam formation.
proposal.rationale: Defines the sewing‑related configuration that influences product durability and recyclability.

proposal.label: Sewing Process
proposal.definition: Confectioning process joining textile parts or components using stitches or seams.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic sewing activity that creates seams in textile products, distinct from product or category classes.

proposal.label: Sorting for Recycling Process
proposal.definition: End‑of‑life process in which collected textile products or materials are segregated into streams suitable for subsequent recycling routes.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific sorting step in textile recycling, distinct from generic recyclability assessment or process.

proposal.label: Sorting Technique Concept
proposal.definition: SKOS concept used to classify a textile sorting technique.
proposal.rationale: Provides a controlled vocabulary for the various sorting methods applied to textile end‑of‑life streams.

proposal.label: Spin Speed
proposal.definition: Care parameter describing the spin speed used in laundering.
proposal.rationale: Captures the laundering spin‑speed setting that influences fabric care and durability, distinct from other textile care properties.

proposal.label: Spinning Limit
proposal.definition: Process parameter expressing the range of yarn counts achievable from a given fibre using a specific spinning system; it depends on the number and thickness of fibres or filaments twisted together.
proposal.rationale: Captures the technical limit of yarn production for a fibre‑spinning system, distinct from other textile process or care properties.

proposal.label: Spinning Method Concept
proposal.definition: SKOS concept used as a controlled value for a spinning method.
proposal.rationale: Provides a controlled vocabulary for the various spinning methods applied in textile production.

proposal.label: Spinning Method Parameter
proposal.definition: When the selected method is represented directly as a controlled value on a spinning process, use txtprc:hasSpinningMethod with a txtprc:SpinningMethodConcept. This class is retained only when the method must be treated explicitly as a process parameter.
proposal.rationale: Captures the explicit process‑level representation of a spinning method, distinct from the concept itself.

proposal.label: Spinning Parameter
proposal.definition: Process parameter relevant to spinning or yarn manufacturing.
proposal.rationale: Captures generic spinning‑related process parameters distinct from the method concept.

proposal.label: Spinning Process
proposal.definition: Specific spinning techniques such as ring spinning, rotor open‑end spinning and air‑jet spinning are represented as SKOS concepts in the spinning method scheme.
proposal.rationale: Captures the high‑level spinning process category distinct from individual method concepts.

proposal.label: Spinning Productivity
proposal.definition: Process parameter expressing the finest yarn count producible from a given fibre while maintaining acceptable performance and minimising end‑breakage rates.
proposal.rationale: Captures the productivity metric of a spinning process, distinct from other performance or quality metrics.

proposal.label: Spinning Speed
proposal.definition: Process parameter describing the speed of spinning.
proposal.rationale: Captures the operational speed of a spinning process, distinct from other performance metrics.

proposal.label: Spinning Tension
proposal.definition: Process parameter describing tension during spinning.
proposal.rationale: Captures the tension applied in a spinning process, distinct from other performance or quality metrics.

proposal.label: Standardisation Feature
proposal.definition: Design feature by which components or interfaces are standardised in a way that may support replacement, repair or upgrade.
proposal.rationale: Captures product design elements that rely on standardisation to enable repair, distinct from generic specifications or common specs.

proposal.label: Storage Condition Parameter
proposal.definition: Care parameter describing storage‑related conditions, such as humidity, sunlight exposure, folding or hanging.
proposal.rationale: Captures the environmental conditions under which a textile product should be stored, distinct from other care or performance properties.

proposal.label: Storage Process
proposal.definition: Use‑phase or care‑related process involving storage of a textile product under specified or unspecified conditions.
proposal.rationale: Captures the act of storing a textile product, distinct from other care or performance properties.

proposal.label: Structural Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Category of failure modes primarily affecting structure, integrity or dimensional behaviour.
proposal.rationale: Provides a generic umbrella for failure modes that impact the physical structure of textile products, distinct from repair or durability ratings.

proposal.label: Study Scope Status Concept
proposal.definition: A SKOS concept used to indicate whether a textile product type is included in, excluded from, or otherwise qualified with respect to a study or regulatory modelling scope.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reusable vocabulary for marking product types against study or regulatory scope, enabling consistent exclusion/inclusion logic in DPPs.

proposal.label: Surface Degradation Phenomenon
proposal.definition: Observed degradation phenomenon affecting the surface condition of a textile material or product, such as pilling, fuzzing or matting.
proposal.rationale: Captures surface‑level degradation that is distinct from chemical concerns or overall durability metrics.

proposal.label: Surface Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Category of failure modes primarily affecting the textile surface, distinct from performance parameters that are captured under Observed Degradation Phenomenon.
proposal.rationale: Separates surface‑specific failures from broader degradation phenomena to maintain module disjointness.

proposal.label: Synthetic Fibre Chemical Recycling Process
proposal.definition: Chemical recycling process for synthetic textile feedstock such as polyester or polyamide 6, producing recovered monomers, oligomers or polymers.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific chemical recycling pathway for synthetic fibres, distinct from general recyclability or content declarations.

proposal.label: Tactile Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Category of failure modes primarily affecting tactile perception, hand feel or comfort‑related touch properties of a textile product or fabric.
proposal.rationale: Separates touch‑related failures from general durability and repair criteria, keeping the module disjoint.

proposal.label: Target Fabric Density
proposal.definition: Process target specification stating the intended thread or loop density of the resulting fabric.
proposal.rationale: Captures the desired fabric density target for a textile process, distinct from general fabric type or product properties.

proposal.label: Target Fabric Mass Per Unit Area
proposal.definition: Specification of the intended mass of fabric per unit surface area for a textile process.
proposal.rationale: Captures the process‑level target for fabric density, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Tear or Rip
proposal.definition: Mechanical failure mode involving rupture, tearing or ripping of textile material under stress, snagging or damage.
proposal.rationale: Captures a specific structural failure distinct from general durability or repair criteria.

proposal.label: Temperature Control
proposal.definition: Process parameter describing the control of temperature during textile manufacturing, processing or care.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic temperature‑control concept for textile processes, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Test Condition
proposal.definition: A controlled assessment condition used in a test protocol, such as temperature, humidity, load, duration, washing cycle or abrasion cycle.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic test‑condition concept for textile assessments, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Test Endpoint
proposal.definition: A defined observation or stopping condition used to determine when a textile test is complete, such as specimen breakdown or a specified appearance change.
proposal.rationale: Captures the termination criterion that signals completion of a textile test protocol.

proposal.label: Test Execution
proposal.definition: An assessment execution that performs a textile test method under controlled test conditions.
proposal.rationale: Captures the concrete instance of a textile test run, linking method, conditions and endpoint.

proposal.label: Test Method
proposal.definition: An assessment method that applies a controlled experimental or inspection procedure to a durability‑related performance parameter.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic test‑method concept for textile durability assessments, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Textile Chemical Function Concept
proposal.definition: A controlled concept describing the technical function performed by a chemical in textile production or treatment.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reusable taxonomy for the functional roles of chemicals used in textile processes, supporting traceability and compliance.

proposal.label: Textile Chemical Recycling Event
proposal.definition: Event in which a textile product or material undergoes a chemical recycling process.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific chemical recycling activity for textiles, distinct from generic recyclability assessment or process.

proposal.label: Textile Chemical Substance
proposal.definition: A substance used or occurring in textile manufacturing, treatment, finishing, coating or related production contexts.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reusable taxonomy for chemicals that appear in textile processes, distinct from generic substances of concern.

proposal.label: Textile Chemical Use Category Concept
proposal.definition: A controlled concept describing whether a chemical is intended to act during processing, remain for product performance, or occur unintentionally.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reusable taxonomy for the intended use of chemicals in textile processes, distinct from generic substances of concern.

proposal.label: Textile Concentration Information
proposal.definition: Concentration information for a substance present in a textile product, expressed at product, component, material‑group or spare‑part level as an exact value, maximum value or range.
proposal.rationale: Captures the concentration data required for SOC reporting, distinct from general material composition.

proposal.label: Textile Context Factor Concept
proposal.definition: A SKOS concept identifying the type of contextual condition observed or declared for a textile product or process execution.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reusable taxonomy for contextual factors that influence textile product performance or compliance.

proposal.label: Textile Context Observation
proposal.definition: A concrete observation, declaration or setting of a contextual condition applying to a textile product or a textile process execution.
proposal.rationale: Captures specific instances of contextual factors that affect textile product performance or compliance.

proposal.label: Textile Fibre
proposal.definition: Unit of matter characterised by flexibility, fineness and a high ratio of length to maximum transverse dimension, suitable for textile applications.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic concept of a textile fibre, matching the upstream term exactly.

proposal.label: Textile Manufacturing Process
proposal.definition: Process involved in the manufacturing or transformation of textile fibres, yarns, fabrics, assemblies or finished textile products.
proposal.rationale: Defines the overarching manufacturing process for textiles, distinct from product or category classes.

proposal.label: Textile Material Group
proposal.definition: A fibre‑, yarn‑ or fabric‑based material grouping within a textile product that serves as a location or mass‑reference unit for substance reporting.
proposal.rationale: Defines the material grouping unit required for SOC substance reporting, distinct from broader textile product categories.

proposal.label: Textile Mechanical Recycling Event
proposal.definition: Event in which a textile product or material undergoes a mechanical recycling process.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific mechanical recycling activity for textiles, distinct from generic recyclability assessment or chemical process.

proposal.label: Textile Process
proposal.definition: Process involved in manufacturing, transforming, using, caring for, repairing, reusing, recycling or treating a textile product, including components used in other products.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic textile process concept, broader than specific manufacturing or recycling subclasses.

proposal.label: Textile Product‑Group SoC Reference
proposal.definition: A versioned reference identifying the textile‑product‑group source that qualifies a substance under the product‑group‑specific type (d) criterion.
proposal.rationale: Provides the specific SoC reference needed for type‑D substance reporting within a textile product group.

proposal.label: Textile Recycling Alert Threshold
proposal.definition: A textile‑sector alert concentration used to inform sorting, recycling or environmentally sound end‑of‑life handling when the substance may hinder circular treatment.
proposal.rationale: Captures the threshold value that triggers a recycling alert for substances that impede circularity in textiles.

proposal.label: Textile Recycling Event
proposal.definition: Concrete occurrence of textile recycling, represented as both a product event and an execution of a textile process.
proposal.rationale: Captures the generic recycling event for textiles, distinct from specific chemical or mechanical sub‑events.

proposal.label: Textile SoC Handling Information
proposal.definition: Textile‑specific instruction information concerning safe use and lifecycle handling in the presence of a substance of concern, covering disassembly, preparation for reuse, reuse, recycling and environmentally sound end‑of‑life management; repair guidance may be added as a textile/JRC extension.
proposal.rationale: Provides the detailed handling guidance required for substances of concern in textile products.

proposal.label: Textile SoC Location Type Concept
proposal.definition: Controlled concept describing a textile‑specific kind of product location used to qualify a substance location statement.
proposal.rationale: Defines the set of permissible location types for substances of concern within textile products.

proposal.label: Textile Substance of Concern Presence Context
proposal.definition: Specialised context for a textile product, textile material group or non‑textile component indicating where and how a substance of concern is present.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific context in which a substance of concern occurs within textile products, enabling precise location statements.

proposal.label: Textile Tracking Threshold
proposal.definition: Threshold for tracking or disclosure of a substance occurrence in a textile product or textile product group.
proposal.rationale: Defines the quantitative or qualitative limit at which a substance must be tracked or disclosed within textile products.

proposal.label: Textile Type D Qualification
proposal.definition: Product‑group‑specific qualification indicating that a substance hinders the reuse or recycling of a textile product or textile material stream.
proposal.rationale: Captures the type‑D status required for substances that impede circularity in textile products.

proposal.label: Textile Waste Source Concept
proposal.definition: Controlled concept classifying textile waste according to the lifecycle stage at which it became waste.
proposal.rationale: Provides a textile‑specific waste source concept that aligns with the broader WasteOriginType but is tailored to textile lifecycle stages.

proposal.label: Thermo‑Mechanical Recycling Process
proposal.definition: Recycling process in which thermoplastic textile polymers are remelted or otherwise thermally and mechanically reprocessed into granulate or fibre material.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific thermo‑mechanical recycling pathway for textile polymers, a narrower form of the generic Recycling Process.

proposal.label: Thread Count
proposal.definition: Fabric construction property indicating the number of threads per specified unit length in a woven textile.
proposal.rationale: Adds a specific woven‑fabric metric distinct from general fabric type or textile category.

proposal.label: Threshold Comparison Operator Concept
proposal.definition: A SKOS concept that identifies the comparison operator (e.g., <, >, =, ≤, ≥) used to evaluate a performance threshold.
proposal.rationale: Provides the controlled vocabulary for operators that compare measured values against threshold limits in textile durability assessments.

proposal.label: Trim Failure
proposal.definition: Component failure mode involving failure of trims or auxiliary components associated with a textile product.
proposal.rationale: Captures a distinct failure of ancillary textile components, separate from general durability or repair criteria.

proposal.label: Twist Level
proposal.definition: Spinning parameter describing the degree or level of twist inserted into a yarn.
proposal.rationale: Captures the yarn twist characteristic used in textile manufacturing, distinct from other process metrics.

proposal.label: Twist Number
proposal.definition: Spinning parameter describing the number of twists inserted into a yarn.
proposal.rationale: Captures the yarn twist count, a distinct textile process attribute not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Upgradability
proposal.definition: Ability of a textile product to be enhanced in functionality, performance, capacity, safety or aesthetics through upgrade actions.
proposal.rationale: Captures the concept of upgrade potential for textile products, distinct from repair or refurbishment.

proposal.label: Upgrade Process
proposal.definition: Textile intervention process intended to enhance the functionality, performance, capacity, safety or aesthetics of a product or component.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific process type for textile upgrades, distinct from repair or refurbishment.

proposal.label: User Acceptance Condition
proposal.definition: Contextual condition concerning whether a user accepts the restored function and potentially changed aesthetics of the product after repair.
proposal.rationale: Captures the post‑repair user acceptance aspect, distinct from repairability metrics.

proposal.label: User Acceptance Status Concept
proposal.definition: Controlled rating‑value concept describing the recorded acceptance status of a repaired product in a stated assessment context.
proposal.rationale: Captures the quantified user acceptance outcome after repair, distinct from general repairability metrics.

proposal.label: Visual Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Category of failure modes primarily affecting visible appearance.
proposal.rationale: Captures failures that alter the visual look of a textile, distinct from quantitative inspection results.

proposal.label: Visual Fibre Characteristic
proposal.definition: Fibre property describing visual aspects such as colour or appearance.
proposal.rationale: Adds a specific visual fibre attribute distinct from general fibre type or essential characteristics.

proposal.label: Visual Performance Parameter
proposal.definition: Category of observed performance parameters related to visual appearance or colour behaviour.
proposal.rationale: Captures measurable visual attributes distinct from generic performance or emissions data.

proposal.label: Washing Temperature
proposal.definition: Care parameter describing the temperature used in a washing process.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific temperature setting for textile washing, distinct from a generic temperature range.

proposal.label: Weave Pattern Specification
proposal.definition: Process target specification stating the weave pattern to be produced.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific weave pattern intended for a textile product, distinct from generic product or display specifications.

proposal.label: Weaving Process
proposal.definition: Fabric manufacturing process in which two sets of yarns are interlaced at right angles on a loom.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile manufacturing activity of weaving, distinct from generic product or process classes.

proposal.label: Wet Processing Process
proposal.definition: Textile manufacturing process involving liquid media, chemical treatment, washing, dyeing, printing or finishing operations.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile manufacturing activity of wet processing, distinct from generic product or process classes.

proposal.label: Wrinkling
proposal.definition: Durability‑related deformation behaviour describing the tendency of a textile material or product to form creases under use or after deformation and recovery cycles.
proposal.rationale: Captures a specific mechanical failure mode distinct from general durability classes.

proposal.label: Yarn Appearance
proposal.definition: Visual characteristic of yarn concerning diameter, hairiness, visible defects and overall appearance.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific yarn‑level visual quality that is not covered by the broader fabric visual inspection term.

proposal.label: Yarn Characteristic
proposal.definition: Characteristic of a yarn that may influence fabric and product durability.
proposal.rationale: Adds a yarn‑level property that is not covered by the existing EssentialCharacteristic or DurabilityClass terms.

proposal.label: Yarn Conditioning
proposal.definition: Spinning or post‑spinning parameter such as steaming that enhances yarn flexibility, strength or evenness.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific textile manufacturing activity of yarn conditioning, distinct from generic durability or fabric type classes.

proposal.label: Yarn Elasticity
proposal.definition: Mechanical property of a yarn describing its ability to deform and recover.
proposal.rationale: Captures yarn‑level elasticity, distinct from fabric durability or spirality tests.

proposal.label: Yarn Hairiness
proposal.definition: Structural property of a yarn describing fibre ends and loops protruding from the yarn body.
proposal.rationale: Captures yarn‑level hairiness, distinct from fabric type or spirality tests.

proposal.label: Yarn Manufacturing Process
proposal.definition: Manufacturing process that transforms fibres or filaments into yarns.
proposal.rationale: Defines the specific textile manufacturing activity of yarn production, distinct from generic product or process classes.

proposal.label: Yarn Softness
proposal.definition: Tactile property of a yarn describing perceived softness or smoothness.
proposal.rationale: Captures yarn‑level softness, distinct from fabric durability or substance concerns.

proposal.label: Yarn Strength
proposal.definition: Mechanical characteristic expressing the ability of a yarn to withstand tensile force without breaking.
proposal.rationale: Adds a yarn‑level tensile strength concept that is not covered by the existing fabric tensile strength term.

proposal.label: Yarn Structural Characteristic
proposal.definition: Characteristic of a yarn concerning its structural regularity or configuration.
proposal.rationale: Adds a yarn‑level structural property that is not covered by the existing EssentialCharacteristic or FabricType terms.

proposal.label: Yarn Tactile Characteristic
proposal.definition: Property of a yarn describing its hand‑feel or tactile behaviour.
proposal.rationale: Adds a yarn‑level tactile descriptor distinct from durability or essential characteristics.

proposal.label: Yarn Uniformity
proposal.definition: Structural property of a yarn indicating consistent thickness and mass along its length.
proposal.rationale: Captures yarn‑level uniformity, distinct from fabric type or robustness assessment.

proposal.label: Yarn Visual Characteristic
proposal.definition: Visible quality of a yarn, covering colour, appearance and surface condition.
proposal.rationale: Captures yarn‑level visual quality, distinct from fabric visual inspection or essential characteristics.

proposal.label: Zipper Failure
proposal.definition: Specific trim failure involving the failure of a zipper or zip fastener.
proposal.rationale: Captures a distinct failure mode of textile trims not covered by general repair or replacement terms.

proposal.label: Addresses Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Relates a repair‑related process execution or priority element to the textile failure mode it addresses.
proposal.rationale: Links a repair action to the specific failure mode it mitigates.

proposal.label: Applies Method
proposal.definition: Links an assessment execution to the reusable assessment method that it performs.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a specific assessment run and the method used, distinct from generic test methods.

proposal.label: Applies To
proposal.definition: Links a textile process type or execution to the textile product it applies to, including component products.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a textile process and the product it is performed on in the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Applies To Endpoint
proposal.definition: Links a performance threshold to the test endpoint it applies to.
proposal.rationale: Represents the relationship between a threshold and its corresponding endpoint, matching the upstream concept.

proposal.label: Assesses Performance Parameter
proposal.definition: Links an assessment execution to the durability‑related performance parameter being evaluated.
proposal.rationale: Represents the relationship between an execution instance and the specific performance parameter it tests, matching the upstream concept.

proposal.label: Assesses Product
proposal.definition: Relates an assessment execution to the product being assessed, including a component used in another product.
proposal.rationale: Captures the link from a specific assessment run to the product (or component) it evaluates, distinct from generic product‑assessment links.

proposal.label: Assesses Recycling Route
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability assessment execution to the recycling route evaluated by that assessment.
proposal.rationale: Links a recyclability assessment to the specific recycling route it examines.

proposal.label: Awards Score Value
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability scoring rule to the dimensionless quantitative score awarded when the rule is satisfied.
proposal.rationale: Captures the numeric score produced by a recyclability scoring rule.

proposal.label: Barrier Applies To Route
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability barrier to the recycling route it hinders.
proposal.rationale: Links a barrier to the specific recycling route it affects.

proposal.label: Calculation Assumption
proposal.definition: Textual statement of an assumption used in calculating, estimating or interpreting an indicator.
proposal.rationale: Captures free‑text assumptions for indicator calculations within the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Can Be Disassembled Without Damage
proposal.definition: Indicates whether the assessed product or element can be disassembled without damage in the assessment context.
proposal.rationale: Captures the binary outcome of a disassembly test within a repairability assessment.

proposal.label: Characteristic Of
proposal.definition: Links a textile structure characteristic occurrence to the textile product it describes, including products used as components of other products.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a textile structure characteristic and the product it applies to.

proposal.label: Concerns Product
proposal.definition: Links a concrete textile process execution to the textile product it concerns, including products used as components of another product.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a process execution and the product it acts upon.

proposal.label: Considers Process Type
proposal.definition: Relates a repairability assessment to the type of repair or other life‑extension process considered.
proposal.rationale: Links an assessment to the specific process type evaluated.

proposal.label: Considers Repair Service
proposal.definition: Relates a repairability assessment to the repair service evaluated or considered as evidence.
proposal.rationale: Links an assessment to the repair service that was examined.

proposal.label: Covers Priority Element Type
proposal.definition: Relates repair guidance to the controlled priority‑element type it covers.
proposal.rationale: Links guidance to the specific priority element type it addresses.

proposal.label: Criterion For Performance Parameter
proposal.definition: Links a decision criterion to the durability‑related performance parameter it applies to.
proposal.rationale: Captures the association between a decision rule and the specific performance parameter it evaluates.

proposal.label: Default Study Scope Status
proposal.definition: Annotation property used on product‑type classes to document their default status with respect to a study or regulatory modelling scope.
proposal.rationale: Provides a lightweight annotation for product classes indicating the default study scope status within the textile‑core module.

proposal.label: Defines Endpoint
proposal.definition: Links a method or standard to the test endpoint or stopping condition it defines.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a method/standard and the endpoint it specifies.

proposal.label: Defines Method
proposal.definition: Links an assessment standard to the assessment method it defines or specifies.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a standard and its concrete method, distinct from generic test methods.

proposal.label: Derived From
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the assessment result or other indicator that serves as evidence in its calculation, aggregation or interpretation.
proposal.rationale: Captures the provenance of an Indicator within the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Derived Using Method
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the assessment, scoring or interpretive method used to derive it.
proposal.rationale: Captures the method employed to calculate an Indicator in the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Evaluated Against Threshold
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the performance threshold used to interpret or classify its value.
proposal.rationale: Captures the threshold that an Indicator is evaluated against in the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Evaluates Criterion
proposal.definition: Links a recyclability criterion result to the controlled criterion it evaluates.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a recyclability assessment result and the specific criterion it tests.

proposal.label: Evidence Status
proposal.definition: Links an ontology resource to one or more controlled concepts that describe how explicitly the resource is supported or how strongly it was reconstructed from source material.
proposal.rationale: Captures the evidence level of a resource, independent of any specific regulation.

proposal.label: Executes Process Type
proposal.definition: Links a concrete textile process execution to the textile process type it instantiates.
proposal.rationale: Captures the instantiation relationship between a process execution and its type in the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Follows Recycling Route
proposal.definition: Relates a textile recycling event to the recycling route it follows.
