proposal.rationale: Links an actual recycling event to the specific route it uses.

proposal.label: Has Assesses Repairability Of
proposal.definition: Links a repairability assessment execution to the textile apparel it evaluates.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a repairability assessment and the apparel it assesses.

proposal.label: Has Barrier Type
proposal.definition: Classifies a recyclability barrier using a controlled barrier concept.
proposal.rationale: Links a barrier instance to its specific type concept.

proposal.label: Has Categorical Value
proposal.definition: Links a process parameter setting to the controlled SKOS concept that represents its categorical value.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a parameter setting and its categorical value in the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Has Categorical Value
proposal.definition: Links a textile context observation to the controlled categorical concept that describes its value.
proposal.rationale: Captures the categorical value of a textile context observation for reporting and analysis.

proposal.label: Has Categorical Value
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to a controlled SKOS concept that represents its categorical, ordinal or rating value.
proposal.rationale: Captures the qualitative value of an indicator for reporting and aggregation.

proposal.label: Has Comparison Operator
proposal.definition: Links a performance threshold to the comparison operator applied to its value.
proposal.rationale: Captures the operator used to evaluate a threshold value.

proposal.label: Has Component Material
proposal.definition: Links a non‑textile component to the material occurrence from which it is made.
proposal.rationale: Captures the material source of a non‑textile component within a textile product.

proposal.label: Has Condition
proposal.definition: Links an assessment execution to the specific condition under which it was performed.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between an assessment run and its operating condition, distinct from generic tested‑conditions.

proposal.label: Has Constituent Indicator
proposal.definition: Links an aggregate or trajectory indicator to a more specific indicator that contributes to its derivation.
proposal.rationale: Captures the hierarchical relationship between indicators for aggregation and reporting.

proposal.label: Has Context Factor Type
proposal.definition: Identifies the controlled context factor concept observed or declared by a textile context observation.
proposal.rationale: Links a context observation to its specific factor type within the textile context module.

proposal.label: Has Context Observation
proposal.definition: Relates a product or a concrete textile process execution to a context observation applying to it.
proposal.rationale: Links a textile entity to its observed context within the textile‑context module.

proposal.label: Has Contributing Indicator
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to a broader indicator that it contributes to.
proposal.rationale: Captures the hierarchical relationship between indicators for aggregation and reporting.

proposal.label: Has Criterion Outcome
proposal.definition: Links a recyclability criterion result to the controlled outcome concept it produces.
proposal.rationale: Captures the outcome of a recyclability assessment against a specific criterion.

proposal.label: Has Criterion Result
proposal.definition: Links an aggregate recyclability assessment result to the individual criterion outcome it contains.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a recyclability assessment and each criterion result it reports.

proposal.label: Has Degradation Expression
proposal.definition: Relates a durability‑related performance characteristic to the degradation phenomenon that expresses its deterioration.
proposal.rationale: Captures the instance‑level link between a performance parameter and its observed degradation within textile durability.

proposal.label: Has Design Feature
proposal.definition: Relates a repairability assessment to the design feature considered in the assessment.
proposal.rationale: Links an assessment to the specific design feature evaluated.

proposal.label: Has External Damage
proposal.definition: Relates a textile product or observation to external damage occurring during use.
proposal.rationale: Captures the link between a textile product and its external damage within the durability module.

proposal.label: Has Fabric Manufacturing Method
proposal.definition: Links a fabric manufacturing process type or execution to the controlled concept that represents its manufacturing method.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a fabric manufacturing process and its method concept in the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Has Failure Expression
proposal.definition: Relates an observed performance parameter to a failure mode that expresses degradation or loss of that parameter.
proposal.rationale: Captures the link between an observed performance parameter and its failure mode within the durability module.

proposal.label: Has Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Relates a textile product to a failure mode observed, expected or considered relevant for that product.
proposal.rationale: Captures the link between a textile product and its relevant failure mode within the durability module.

proposal.label: Has Failure Mode
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the textile failure mode it interprets or uses in its derivation.
proposal.rationale: Provides the relationship between an Indicator and a specific FailureMode in the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Has Fibre Component
proposal.definition: Links a textile product to the fibre type concept that constitutes part of its composition.
proposal.rationale: Captures the fibre composition of a textile product for traceability and reporting.

proposal.label: Has Fibre Composition Component
proposal.definition: Relates a textile product to a structured fibre composition component that describes the fibre mix of its construction.
proposal.rationale: Captures the detailed fibre‑level composition of a textile product within the textile‑core module.

proposal.label: Has Indicator
proposal.definition: Links a textile product to an indicator that describes or interprets it.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a product and its associated indicator.

proposal.label: Has Interactive Repair Support
proposal.definition: Relates a repair service to interactive real‑time repair support.
proposal.rationale: Links a repair service to the concept that captures interactive support, using the closest existing class.

proposal.label: Has Life‑Extension Intervention Aspect
proposal.definition: Relates a textile apparel item to the life‑extension intervention aspect that applies to it.
proposal.rationale: Links apparel to the specific life‑extension aspect relevant for repairability.

proposal.label: Has Maximum Score Value
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability scoring method to the maximum dimensionless score value defined by that method.
proposal.rationale: Links a scoring method to its upper score bound.

proposal.label: Has Measurement Parameter
proposal.definition: Links a method or assessment condition to the protocol parameter it specifies.
proposal.rationale: Captures the parameter used in a measurement protocol.

proposal.label: Has Minimum Score Value
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability scoring method to the minimum dimensionless score value defined by that method.
proposal.rationale: Links a scoring method to its lower score bound.

proposal.label: Has New Textile Product
proposal.definition: Links a remanufacturing execution to the new textile product it produces.
proposal.rationale: Captures the output of a remanufacturing process as a textile product.

proposal.label: Has Non‑Textile Component
proposal.definition: Links a textile product to a non‑textile component physically integrated into it.
proposal.rationale: Captures the physical integration of a non‑textile component within a textile product.

proposal.label: Has Non‑Textile Component Type
proposal.definition: Links a non‑textile component to the controlled concept that describes its type.
proposal.rationale: Captures the type of a non‑textile component within a textile product, aligning with existing component‑type terminology.

proposal.label: Has Non‑Textile Material Mass Fraction
proposal.definition: Relates a textile product to the mass fraction represented by non‑textile materials in its composition.
proposal.rationale: Captures the proportion of non‑textile material in a textile product within the textile‑core module.

proposal.label: Has Observed Degradation Phenomenon
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the observed textile degradation phenomenon it interprets.
proposal.rationale: Provides a direct association between an Indicator and the specific degradation phenomenon it addresses in the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Has Observed Performance Parameter
proposal.definition: Links a textile product to the observed performance parameter that informs its durability assessment.
proposal.rationale: Captures durability‑relevant performance data for a textile product.

proposal.label: Has Packaging Material
proposal.definition: Links a textile product to the packaging material used for its packaging, transport, storage or delivery.
proposal.rationale: Captures the material used for packaging a textile product, aligning with PPWR packaging concepts.

proposal.label: Has Packaging Material Type
proposal.definition: Links a packaging material to the controlled concept that describes its type.
proposal.rationale: Captures the type of packaging material used for a textile product, aligning with PPWR packaging tier concepts.

proposal.label: Has Parameter Setting
proposal.definition: Links an assessment execution or condition to a concrete measurement parameter setting.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific setting of a measurement parameter used in an assessment.

proposal.label: Has Parameter Value
proposal.definition: Links a measurement parameter setting to the quantitative value it represents.
proposal.rationale: Captures the numeric value of a specific measurement parameter setting.

proposal.label: Has Performance Parameter
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the durability‑related performance parameter it interprets.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between an Indicator and a specific ObservedPerformanceParameter in the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Has Presence Chemical Function
proposal.definition: Links a textile substance occurrence to the chemical function performed in that textile context.
proposal.rationale: Captures the chemical function of a substance present in a textile product.

proposal.label: Has Presence Use Category
proposal.definition: Classifies a textile chemical occurrence by its association with process use, intended performance use or unintended presence.
proposal.rationale: Links a textile substance‑of‑concern occurrence to the use category that applies to that specific instance.

proposal.label: Has Priority Repair Element
proposal.definition: Relates a repairability assessment to the priority repair element considered in that assessment.
proposal.rationale: Links an assessment to the specific priority repair element it evaluates.

proposal.label: Has Priority Repair Element Type
proposal.definition: Assigns a controlled element type to a priority repair element role.
proposal.rationale: Links a priority repair element to its specific type concept.

proposal.label: Has Process Execution
proposal.definition: Links a textile product, including component products, to the concrete process execution applied to it or recorded in its lifecycle.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a textile product and its process execution in the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Has Process Method
proposal.definition: Links a textile process type or concrete execution to the controlled concept that identifies the selected process method.
proposal.rationale: Captures the method chosen for a textile process, using the controlled concept class.

proposal.label: Has Process Parameter
proposal.definition: Links a textile process type to the process parameter or target specification relevant to that process.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a textile process and its defined parameters in the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Has Process Parameter Setting
proposal.definition: Links a concrete textile process execution to the specific parameter setting used in that execution.
proposal.rationale: Captures the concrete parameter setting applied to a textile process execution in the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Has Product
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the textile product it describes or interprets.
proposal.rationale: Captures the product that an indicator refers to for reporting and analysis.

proposal.label: Has Quantitative Value
proposal.definition: Links a textile context observation to its quantitative value expressed as a decimal with an appropriate unit code.
proposal.rationale: Captures the numeric value of a textile context observation for reporting and analysis.

proposal.label: Has Quantity Kind
proposal.definition: Links a quantitative value to the kind of quantity it expresses.
proposal.rationale: Captures the quantity kind of a quantitative value within the textile connector.

proposal.label: Has Rating Value
proposal.definition: Links a measurement result to the controlled rating value or grade it yields.
proposal.rationale: Captures the qualitative rating derived from a measurement.

proposal.label: Has Recovered Material Quality Result
proposal.definition: Links an assessment or recycling result to the quality outcome for a recovered material.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a recyclability assessment and the quality result of recovered material.

proposal.label: Has Recyclability Barrier
proposal.definition: Links a recyclability assessment result to a barrier identified during the assessment.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a recyclability assessment and any barrier found.

proposal.label: Has Recyclability Label
proposal.definition: Links a recyclability score to the controlled label that describes the method‑specific result.
proposal.rationale: Captures the association between a recyclability assessment score and its method‑specific label.

proposal.label: Has Recyclability Technology Level
proposal.definition: Classifies a recyclability assessment result by the product‑technology level defined in the Textile Connector vocabulary.
proposal.rationale: Links an assessment outcome to the technology‑level concept that indicates its recyclability context.

proposal.label: Has Recyclable Mass Fraction Value
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability assessment result to the quantitative mass fraction judged recyclable for the specified route and conditions.
proposal.rationale: Links an assessment outcome to the numeric fraction that indicates how much mass is considered recyclable.

proposal.label: Has Recycled Content Assessment
proposal.definition: Links a textile product to the execution of its recycled‑content assessment.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a textile product and its recycled‑content assessment execution.

proposal.label: Has Recycled Content Technology Level
proposal.definition: Classifies a recycled‑content assessment result by the product technology level used in the assessment.
proposal.rationale: Links assessment results to the technology level concept defined in Textile Connector.

proposal.label: Has Recycled Material Mass Value
proposal.definition: Relates a recycled‑content declaration to the absolute mass of recycled material included in the product.
proposal.rationale: Links a declaration to the numeric mass of recycled material it records.

proposal.label: Has Recycling Loop
proposal.definition: Links a route, assessment result or event to the intended material‑loop destination.
proposal.rationale: Captures the destination loop for a recycling activity or assessment.

proposal.label: Has Recycling Yield Result
proposal.definition: Relates a textile recycling event to the result reporting the recovered‑material yield of that event.
proposal.rationale: Links a recycling event to the quantitative yield outcome it produced.

proposal.label: Has Recycling Yield Value
proposal.definition: Relates a recycling yield result to its quantitative value.
proposal.rationale: Links a yield result to the numeric value it reports.

proposal.label: Has Reference Duration
proposal.definition: Links a reference period to its quantitative duration expressed as an ISO‑8601 duration.
proposal.rationale: Captures the length of a reference period for lifecycle or test data.

proposal.label: Has Reference Period
proposal.definition: Relates a textile context observation to the structured time interval for which it is valid or observed.
proposal.rationale: Links a context observation to the period it covers within the textile‑context module.

proposal.label: Has Reference Period
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the structured temporal interval it applies to.
proposal.rationale: Captures the reference period of an Indicator in the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Has Reference Product Mass Value
proposal.definition: Relates a recycled‑content declaration to the reference product mass, excluding trims where the applicable method requires this basis.
proposal.rationale: Links a declaration to the numeric reference product mass it uses.

proposal.label: Has Repair Cost Condition
proposal.definition: Links a repairability assessment to the repair‑cost condition considered.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a repairability assessment and its cost condition.

proposal.label: Has Repair Cost‑to‑New Product Price Ratio
proposal.definition: Relates a repair‑cost condition to the dimensionless ratio of repair cost versus price of an equivalent new product.
proposal.rationale: Links a cost condition to the quantitative ratio it represents.

proposal.label: Has Repair Price Transparency
proposal.definition: Indicates whether repair‑price or cost information is transparently available for a repair service.
proposal.rationale: Adds a boolean flag to capture price‑transparency for repair services.
proposal.caveat: No existing RepairService class; domain left empty pending definition.

proposal.label: Has Repair Response Time Value
proposal.definition: Relates a repair service to the quantitative response‑time value expressed in an SI time unit.
proposal.rationale: Adds a numeric response‑time property for repair services.
proposal.caveat: RepairService class not yet defined; domain left empty pending definition.

proposal.label: Has Repair Service Configuration
proposal.definition: Relates a repairability assessment result to the BC, BAT or BNAT service‑and‑guidance configuration defined in JRC Table 48.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific service configuration that applies to a repairability assessment.

proposal.label: Has Repairability Assessment
proposal.definition: Links a textile apparel to the repairability assessment execution that evaluates it.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a textile product and its repairability assessment.

proposal.label: Has Rule Evaluates Criterion
proposal.definition: Links a recyclability scoring rule to the criterion it evaluates.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a scoring rule and its evaluated criterion.

proposal.label: Has Rule Uses Threshold
proposal.definition: Links a recyclability scoring rule to the performance threshold it applies.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a scoring rule and its threshold.

proposal.label: Has Scale Value
proposal.definition: Links a rating scale to one of its controlled rating values.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a rating scale and its specific value within the assessment framework.

proposal.label: Has Scoring Rule
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability scoring method to the specific scoring rule it employs.
proposal.rationale: Links a scoring method to the rule that defines its calculation.

proposal.label: Has Spinning Method
proposal.definition: Links a spinning process type or concrete execution to the controlled spinning‑method concept that describes how fibers are spun into yarn.
proposal.rationale: Captures the spinning method used in a textile process within the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Has Structural Characteristic
proposal.definition: Links a textile product, including products used as components of other products, to the occurrence of a textile structure characteristic.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a textile product and its structural characteristics.

proposal.label: Has Study Scope Status
proposal.definition: Relates a textile product instance to the controlled study scope status concept that applies to it.
proposal.rationale: Captures the study‑scope status of a textile product within the textile‑core module.

proposal.label: Has Textile Apparel Product Type
proposal.definition: Links a textile apparel product to the controlled concept that specifies its apparel product type.
proposal.rationale: Captures the apparel product type for traceability and regulatory reporting.

proposal.label: Has Textile Chemical Use Category
proposal.definition: Links a textile chemical substance to the controlled category that indicates whether it is used as a process chemical, a performance chemical or occurs unintentionally.
proposal.rationale: Captures the intended use category of a textile chemical substance for regulatory reporting.

proposal.label: Has Textile Handling Information
proposal.definition: Links a textile substance‑of‑concern presence context to the specific safe‑use or lifecycle handling information for that textile.
proposal.rationale: Captures handling guidance for a chemical present in a textile context.

proposal.label: Has Textile Location Type
proposal.definition: Links a location information object to the controlled textile‑specific location type that applies to the context.
proposal.rationale: Captures the textile‑specific location type for a given location information instance.

proposal.label: Has Textile Product‑Group Reference
proposal.definition: Links a textile type‑D qualification to the versioned textile product‑group reference that supports it.
proposal.rationale: Captures the reference from a type‑D qualification to its supporting product‑group.

proposal.label: Has Textual Value
proposal.definition: Links a process parameter setting to the free‑text value used when no controlled concept is available.
proposal.rationale: Captures the textual value of a textile process parameter setting in the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Has Threshold For Recycled Content Source
proposal.definition: Links a recycled‑content performance threshold to the source category it constrains.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a threshold and the recycled‑content source it applies to.

proposal.label: Has Threshold Rating Value
proposal.definition: Links a performance threshold to the controlled rating value used as its comparison level.
proposal.rationale: Captures the rating value that defines a performance threshold.

proposal.label: Has User Acceptance Condition
proposal.definition: Relates a repairability assessment to the condition describing user acceptance of the product after repair.
proposal.rationale: Links a repairability assessment to the user‑acceptance condition that applies.

proposal.label: Has User Acceptance Status
proposal.definition: Links a user‑acceptance condition to the controlled acceptance status recorded in the assessment context.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a user‑acceptance condition and its status.

proposal.label: Has Uses Collection Scheme
proposal.definition: Links a collection‑for‑recycling process type or configuration to the collection scheme it uses.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a recycling collection process and its associated scheme.

proposal.label: In Scale
proposal.definition: Links a rating value to the rating scale it belongs to.
proposal.rationale: Captures the association between a rating value and its scale.

proposal.label: Informs Estimate Of
proposal.definition: Links supporting indicator evidence to a lifetime‑of‑product indicator whose value is inferred from that evidence.
proposal.rationale: Captures the inference relationship between evidence indicators and a lifetime‑of‑product indicator in the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Is Available In Whole Sales Region
proposal.definition: Indicates whether the repair service is available throughout the region where the textile product is sold.
proposal.rationale: Captures the regional availability of a repair service for textile products.

proposal.label: Is Evaluated Against
proposal.definition: Links an assessment result to the decision criterion against which it is evaluated.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a result and its evaluation criterion.

proposal.label: Is Indicator Of
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the textile product it describes or interprets.
proposal.rationale: Inverse of hasIndicator, capturing the product that an indicator refers to.

proposal.label: Is Interpreted By
proposal.definition: Links a measurement result to the interpretation scale used for its reading.
proposal.rationale: Captures the scale that gives meaning to a measurement value.

proposal.label: Is Qualified By Parameter Setting
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to the concrete measurement‑parameter setting that defines its meaning, such as number and type of cycles.
proposal.rationale: Captures the qualification of an Indicator by a specific measurement‑parameter setting in the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: Is Structured By Measurement Parameter
proposal.definition: Links a series or trajectory indicator to the measurement parameter that serves as its organising axis.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between an Indicator and the measurement parameter that structures its values in the textile‑indicator module.

proposal.label: JRC Scope Condition
proposal.definition: Annotation specifying a textual condition that governs inclusion of a textile product class or category in the JRC preparatory study scope.
proposal.rationale: Captures the inclusion condition for JRC scope within the textile‑core module.

proposal.label: May Result In
proposal.definition: Indicates that an external damage event may lead to a specific failure mode.
proposal.rationale: Links external damage to the failure mode it can cause within the durability module.

proposal.label: Measures Performance Parameter
proposal.definition: Links a test method to the durability‑related performance parameter it is designed to assess.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a test method and the performance parameter it evaluates.

proposal.label: Negatively Affects
proposal.definition: Indicates that a failure mode, degradation phenomenon or damage has a negative impact on a durability‑related aspect of the textile product.
proposal.rationale: Links adverse durability effects to the corresponding durability information within the textile‑durability module.

proposal.label: Observation Of
proposal.definition: Relates a textile context observation to the product or process execution it applies to.
proposal.rationale: Links a context observation to the specific textile entity (product or process execution) it describes.

proposal.label: Parameter Of Process
proposal.definition: Links a process parameter or target specification to the textile process type that it configures or specifies.
proposal.rationale: Captures the association between a textile process parameter and the process it defines within the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Period End
proposal.definition: End date and time of a reference period.
proposal.rationale: Captures the end timestamp of a reference period within the textile connector.

proposal.label: Period Start
proposal.definition: Start date and time of a reference period.
proposal.rationale: Captures the start timestamp of a reference period within the textile connector.

proposal.label: Produces Output
proposal.definition: Links a textile process type or execution to the textile product produced as an output, including products that may later serve as components of other products.
proposal.rationale: Captures the output relationship of a textile process within the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Produces Result
proposal.definition: Links an assessment execution to the result it generates.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a test run and its outcome.

proposal.label: Provided By
proposal.definition: Links a repair service to the actor that provides or organizes it.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a repair service and its provider actor.

proposal.label: Provides Guidance
proposal.definition: Links a repair service to the guidance made available through that service.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a repair service and its guidance content.

proposal.label: Refers To Component
proposal.definition: Links a priority repair element role to the concrete non‑textile component it targets.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a priority repair element and the non‑textile component it addresses.

proposal.label: Refers To Non‑Textile Component
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability barrier to the non‑textile component that is responsible for or affected by the barrier.
proposal.rationale: Links a barrier to the specific non‑textile component it concerns.

proposal.label: Refers To Substance Presence
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability barrier to the textile substance‑of‑concern presence context that it addresses or is affected by.
proposal.rationale: Links a barrier to the specific substance‑presence context it concerns.

proposal.label: Refers To Textile Element
proposal.definition: Links a priority repair element role to the textile product that is used as a component or repairable element.
proposal.rationale: Captures the textile element referenced by a priority repair element.

proposal.label: Relevant To Textile Process
proposal.definition: Links a textile substance‑of‑concern presence context to the textile process type that introduced, used, transformed or is affected by that substance.
proposal.rationale: Captures the textile process relevant to a specific substance occurrence.

proposal.label: Requires Route Stage
proposal.definition: Relates a recycling route to the collection, sorting, preparation or recycling stage that it requires.
proposal.rationale: Links a recycling route to the specific end‑of‑life process stage it mandates.

proposal.label: Result For Recycling Route
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability assessment result to the recycling route for which it is valid.
proposal.rationale: Links an assessment result to the specific recycling route it applies to.

proposal.label: Result Of Assessment
proposal.definition: Links an assessment result to the execution that produced it.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a specific assessment outcome and its originating execution.

proposal.label: Rule Applies To Route
proposal.definition: Relates a recyclability scoring rule to the recycling route in which it is applicable.
proposal.rationale: Links a scoring rule to the specific recycling route it governs.

proposal.label: Setting For Parameter
proposal.definition: Links a concrete parameter setting to the measurement parameter it configures.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a setting and the parameter it defines.

proposal.label: Setting For Process Parameter
proposal.definition: Relates a concrete process parameter setting to the process parameter type or target specification it instantiates.
proposal.rationale: Captures the instantiation link between a parameter setting and its defining process parameter in the textile‑process module.

proposal.label: Source Locator
proposal.definition: Human‑readable reference to the section, page, table, figure, line range or file location in a cited source that supports an ontology resource.
proposal.rationale: Captures the location of supporting evidence for a resource within the textile connector.

proposal.label: Supports Assessment Of
proposal.definition: Links an indicator to a durability concept whose assessment it supports without asserting equivalence.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship where an indicator underpins a durability assessment.

proposal.label: Supports Process Type
